admission.authority: Original selected-record scope, current actual CURATOR class3 or global class8 grant, before reference lock
admission.finality: Exact supplement identity enters PERCEPTUAL input and locked component identity; absent or mismatched closure/replay refuses
admission.historical: Original V1 receipt/payload/profile and reads remain available; CURATED and BYTE_EXACT finality identities unchanged

implementationIndex: Canonical sorted compact JSON original four path to lowercase raw-file SHA256 hex, without 0x or newline
metricAndReport: Unchanged original seven-field Metric and 6529STREAM_PERCEPTUAL_REPORT_V1 preimage
parameters: Exact bytes whose Keccak is original Metric.parametersHash

replay.inputs: Exact source-derived canonical JSON contextHash/environmentHash/evaluatedAt/threshold and capture-major firstSha256/secondSha256/viewport dimensions
replay.qualification: Publisher-authenticated attributed restored execution. Offline validator must restore and run archived command, verify loaded dependencies/OS prerequisites and output. Declaration or source hash alone is insufficient.
replay.result: Exit code zero, original reportHash, runtimeHash and inputHash, nonempty retained transcript, time no earlier than original metric evaluation
replay.transcriptEncoding: abi.encode(keccak256("6529STREAM_METRIC_TRANSCRIPT_V1"),runtimeHash,contextHash,reportHash,inputsHash,uint64(executedAt),uint32(exitCode),bytes(originalCanonicalDiagnosticJSON)); exact canonical tuple and all copied fields checked onchain

runtime.environment: Same original Publication.environment objectHash and manifestHash
runtime.members: Exact entire metric/ prefix of original environment.packageFiles, in the same strictly ordered path sequence
runtime.platform: Original Windows AMD64 profile and exact declared OS prerequisite files; no claim to archive OS licenses or semantics
